Market today: The tech wreck is brutal, driven by chip sector panic and broad market sell-offs. Your concentrated tech/chip book, especially on margin, is taking a massive hit.

Your holdings: SMCI (-50.66%), SOXL (-86.26%), MU (-74.08%), PLTU (-46.3%), SPAL (-54.99%), and METU (-34.56%) are all in deep water and marked SELL. QQQ (-14.86%) and SPY (-6.07%) are also weak. CRWD (+31.16%) is your only winner but is marked TRIM.

Watch: Keep an eye on the broader market indices (SPY, QQQ) for any signs of stabilization. Also, watch Nvidia's continued price action.

Bottom line: The tech sector is in freefall; focus on damage control and risk management.
plays: Consider trimming CRWD if it shows weakness to lock in some gains.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
